justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/inline/package-info.java` and the 8 production classes in the package (`AbstractInliningDynamicTypeBuilder.java`, `DecoratingDynamicTypeBuilder.java`, `RedefinitionDynamicTypeBuilder.java`, `RebaseDynamicTypeBuilder.java`, `RebaseImplementationTarget.java`, `MethodRebaseResolver.java`, `MethodNameTransformer.java`, `InliningImplementationMatcher.java`). The package is about 2272 LOC total and is tightly cohesive around inline type enhancement/redefinition/rebasing, with 4 builder classes plus small support types; I did not find evidence of broad, cross-domain responsibility concentration or an unusually large, decomposable package that would justify a God Component verdict.
